scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && expo install --check
scripts.build:production: npm run check && npm run signing:check && EXPO_NO_CAPABILITY_SYNC=1 npx eas-cli@latest build --platform all --profile production
scripts.build:production:ios: npm run check && python3 scripts/check-signing.py ios && EXPO_NO_CAPABILITY_SYNC=1 npx eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.build:production:android: npm run check && python3 scripts/check-signing.py android && EXPO_NO_CAPABILITY_SYNC=1 npx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile production
